name: The Villager
reviewNotes:
Added for its own event calendar in src/content/sources (PR #8). The dance floor has not been researched yet.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Website, email, phone and address confirmed on the venue's own site; address and phone also match Google Maps. The venue site does not publish hours: hours come from the Bing local listing, and Google Maps (which only showed the current day) agrees for Sunday 11 AM-3 AM; please re-check. Farmingdale is in Nassau County. Part of the LFRG restaurant group, which also runs a separate The Villager in Babylon (thevillagerbabylon.com) - not the same venue. Live music happens in the outdoor beer garden area in season; the site does not describe a dance floor. Photos come from the Farmingdale site's own Squarespace account (not the Babylon site). The logo is white on a transparent background, so it needs a dark backdrop. Photo 3 shows a bar that looks like the outdoor bar in the beer garden (daylight from the side), so it is tagged 'other'.
hours: Mon-Wed 3 PM-3 AM; Thu-Sun 11 AM-3 AM
description: A gastropub on Main Street in downtown Farmingdale with 24 rotating draft beers and a large outdoor beer garden. Local bands and singers play most Thursday, Friday and Saturday evenings.
